quote: Ruth Moufang introduced quasigroups in her paper 'Zur Struktur von Alternativkörpern' published in Mathematische Annalen, volume 110, pages 416–430
note: Loop theory and quasigroup theory developed gradually beginning with Moufang's foundational 1935 work on quasigroups. The field expanded with Gerrit Bol's work in 1937 (Bol loops) and formalization by the Chicago School in the early 1940s. The Wikipedia article 'Problems in loop theory and quasigroup theory' focuses on contemporary open problems from Loops conferences (starting 1999) rather than historical origins.
